final_claim.narrative: No genuine closure wave. Although all 10 triangles among these nodes do eventually close, none closes within 800 time units of its supporting wedge — and none even within 2000. The median closing lag is ~3464. Wedges complete around t=38100-40300 while the closing edges arrive uniformly later, around t=41400-43100, forming a single late clump rather than prompt, causally-linked closure. The apparent structure is an artifact of static connectivity: triangles exist when time is ignored, but the temporal ordering shows the closing interactions lag their support by roughly four times the required threshold. Controls exclude the standard alternatives: overall volume is high and early bursts are present, node degrees are low and essentially non-repeating (repeat ratio 0.006), the 59-248 link is a single direct event rather than a wedge closure, and widening the window to [30000,48000] still yields zero prompt closures out of 13 triangles.
